summary:
Analysis of ಸ್ತೋತ್ರಮಾಲಾ APK (v2.1.8) - a native Android Kannada stotra/mantra app.
Contains 4,590 stotras across 38 categories.
UI: search list → text reader with font size slider.
Architecture: Native Java/Kotlin, all text hardcoded in activities, Google AdMob ads, favorites via long-press.
